analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI remains at 44.4 in neutral territory, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it continues weak convergence in negative territory. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.61x the 5-day average, confirming a lack of directional momentum. The price is trading sideways between the $240,000 support and the $267,000 short-term resistance.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($240,000) vs SMA5 ($231,500)/SMA20 ($255,150)/SMA50 ($297,416) — Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20, below long-term SMA50.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($258,645)/SMA200 ($194,170) — Mid-to-long term trend is weak.
· 52-week position (57.2%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.7 → 44.4) + Exited oversold, continuing in neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4054.6654 → -181.6715) + Improving in negative territory, maintaining weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $255,150) + Bandwidth at 36.63% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($167,300) + Based on Pivot S1 ($182,800).
· Swing resistance ($370,000) + Resistance at R1 ($303,600).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $189,200, 20-day low $189,200, 5-day high $267,000, 20-day high $310,000) — Sideways pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.61x) + Confidence in price movement is weakened.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Consider buying upon confirmation of $240,000 support, strengthen buy on break of $267,000.
